description: Search across the claims that organizations have published openly on OTP: how they coordinate, what they learned, what failed, and how confident they are in each. Call this when someone wants evidence on a specific practice, wants to know what other organizations do about a problem, or asks what the network has actually learned. Returns published public material only.

query.description: What to search for, in plain language. E.g. "how do teams handle agent escalation".

name: search_public_claims
title: Search what organizations have published about how they work
